                System.out.println(allbutone * (cnt / 2) % MOD);
            } else {
                long k = cnt / 2;
                long[] mat = { k, k + 1, k + 1, k };
                long[] res = matPow(mat, n * m);
                System.out.println(res[0]);
            }
        }
    }

    static long pow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                res = res * a % MOD;
            }
            a = a * a % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long[] matMul(long[] x, long[] y) {

            (x[0] * y[0] + x[1] * y[2]) % MOD,
